name: emploive
description: Search new jobs from over 90,000 company careers pages and manage Emploive job alerts.

interface.longDescription: Emploive is a job search and job alert tool. It finds new jobs and internships from over 90,000 companies, usually minutes after they're posted. It is simple to get started: search for roles that match what you are looking for, and set up notifications to know when new roles go live.
defaultPrompt: Find the newest software engineering internships in San Francisco.
Set up a job alert for remote data science roles.
What new jobs match my trackers?

positive.prompt: Find the newest software engineering internships in the United States.
positive.expected_behavior: Search without sign-in. Use Internship, Software Engineer, and United States filters. Return matching open jobs, newest first. Include title, company, location, pay when available, age, and the Emploive job link. If no jobs match, say so.

positive.description: Search by experience, position, and location.
positive.prompt: Show me new grad data science jobs in New York.
positive.expected_behavior: Search without sign-in. Use the New Grad experience level, Data Science position, and New York location. Show matching jobs with Emploive links. Explain the interpreted location if relevant. Do not invent results.

positive.description: Read job details after a search.
positive.prompt: Find the newest software engineering internship in the United States. Show its details and explain how I can apply.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for an internship, then call get_job with a returned job ID. Describe the job using the returned data. Include its Emploive job link. Show an employer application link only when the server returns it. Without results, explain that no matching job is available.

positive.description: Create a tracker after confirmation and sign-in.
positive.prompt: Create an Emploive tracker named Reviewer remote product roles for remote full-time Product Manager jobs. Send email alerts daily. I confirm these settings.
positive.expected_behavior: Request Emploive sign-in if needed. After authorization, create one tracker with the specified name, role, position, work model, enabled email alerts, and 1440-minute frequency. Confirm the saved settings and show available matches. Respect account limits.

positive.description: Read the signed-in reviewer account trackers and their matches.
positive.prompt: List my Emploive trackers and show the newest matching jobs for each one.
positive.expected_behavior: Request Emploive sign-in if needed. List only this account's trackers. Call get_tracker_jobs with each returned tracker ID. Show matching jobs with Emploive links, or explain that a tracker has no matches. If no trackers exist, explain that state.

negative.description: Document writing does not require Emploive. Do not call Emploive tools. Write the letter or ask for details needed to write it.
negative.prompt: Write a short cover letter for a marketing job.

negative.description: Salary statistics are outside Emploive job search. Do not call Emploive tools. Use another suitable source or explain that job listings do not establish an average salary.
negative.prompt: What is the average salary of a nurse in Texas?

negative.description: Emploive does not submit job applications. Do not call Emploive tools. Explain that the user submits applications on the employer website. Do not claim to have applied.
negative.prompt: Submit a job application for me through Emploive.

publication.release_notes: Search current jobs and internships. Read job details. Create and manage trackers. Review new matches. Search works without sign-in. Tracker actions require an Emploive account.
